papers.title: Neutrino mass constraints in interacting dark energy models after DESI DR2
papers.abstract: Recent DESI observations indicate a deviation from the $Λ$CDM model, showing a preference for dynamical dark energy and thereby relaxing the upper limit on the neutrino mass within this framework. This deviation can also be explained by the presence of an interaction between dark energy and dark matter. In this work, we investigate the cosmological upper bounds on the total neutrino mass ($\sum m_ν$) across four different interacting dark energy (IDE) models. The present analysis employs the latest DESI baryon acoustic oscillation, cosmic microwave background, and type Ia supernova datasets. These results demonstrate that the upper bounds on $\sum m_ν$ exhibit profound sensitivity to the specific phenomenological formulation of the interaction term. While the I$Λ$CDM2 model ($Q \propto H ρ_{\mathrm{c}}$) substantially relaxes the stringent upper limit ($\sum m_ν < 0.129$ eV at 95% confidence level), notably the I$Λ$CDM3 model ($Q \propto H_0 ρ_{\mathrm{de}}$), severely compresses the allowed parameter space, yielding a highly restrictive bound of $\sum m_ν < 0.051$ eV. Furthermore, rigorous goodness-of-fit evaluations utilizing the Deviance Information Criterion and $Δχ^2_{\mathrm{MAP}}$ indicate that the current observational data statistically favor these mass-suppressing IDE models. This establishes an exacerbated statistical tension between the observationally preferred IDE scenarios and the normal hierarchy lower bound ($\sim 0.06$ eV) determined by terrestrial neutrino oscillation experiments.

analysis.title_zh: DESI DR2 之后相互作用暗能量模型中的中微子质量约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 DESI DR2 之后，在四种相互作用暗能量模型中宇宙学数据对总中微子质量的上限如何变化。摘要报告，DESI BAO、CMB 与 Ia 型超新星联合约束显示质量上限强烈依赖相互作用项形式，其中某些模型会给出非常紧的上限并与地面中微子振荡实验给出的正常质量序下限形成统计张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接涉及 CMB 参数推断中的关键退化关系：中微子质量、暗能量演化、暗物质-暗能量相互作用和 BAO 标尺会共同影响距离与结构增长约束。对于 CMB 读者，它提示在扩展暗能量模型中引用中微子质量上限时，不能只看数值，还必须检查相互作用参数化和数据组合。
key_points: 使用 DESI BAO、CMB 和 Ia 型超新星数据约束相互作用暗能量模型中的中微子质量。
总中微子质量上限对暗能量-暗物质相互作用项形式非常敏感。
摘要声称某些数据偏好的 IDE 模型会加剧与振荡实验正常质量序下限的张力。
methods: DESI DR2 重子声学振荡数据
四种相互作用暗能量模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对所用 CMB 数据组合、DESI DR2 与超新星样本的具体选择，以及四种 Q 项参数化的先验和稳定性条件；尤其要检查低于正常质量序下限的约束是否由模型先验、数据组合或拟合优度判据驱动。

papers.title: Constraints on the gravitational potential from DESI DR2 BAO and its implications for the local void scenario
papers.abstract: We constrain the difference in gravitational potential between our location and sources at $z \gtrsim 0.3$ using datasets at those redshifts. Our motivation is that the Hubble tension might be caused by a local void, as suggested by galaxy number counts. This would increase the redshift through outflow and gravitational redshift (GR). Only the latter is important at high redshift, where a void contributes a fixed additional GR contribution of $z_0$ due to our location on a potential hill. This $z_0$ model has various subtle effects that were not previously considered, including a hotter CMB and reduced BAO scale $r_{\rm d}$. We test whether $z_0$ can have the previously expected value of 0.84%, which was based on fitting void parameters to galaxy number counts and local $H_0$ measurements. Combining BBN, CMB, BAO, and CC datasets at $z > 0.5$, we find that $z_0 = -0.4^{+0.8}_{-0.9}\%$, which rises to $-0.1 \pm 0.7\%$ when extending our analysis down to $z > 0.29$. Although the results prefer the standard value of $z_0 = 0$, the best-fitting model with $z_0 = 0.84\%$ fits the data almost as well as $Λ$CDM, with $Δχ^2 < 2$. We find that $Λ$CDM faces a $3.07σ$ BAO anomaly in the standard $(H_0 r_{\rm d}, Ω_{\rm m})$ parameter space, where different regions are preferred by BAO and non-BAO datasets from $z > 0.29$. Fixing $z_0 = 0.84\%$ reduces this to $2.79σ$. This suggests that a local void large enough to solve the Hubble tension cannot be ruled out by higher-redshift datasets despite its novel impacts on them.

papers.title: Interacting dark energy constraints from Fermi GRBs and Pantheon+ SNe Ia with full GRB covariance
papers.abstract: The standard $Λ$CDM model faces long-standing theoretical and observational problems, such as the Hubble tension, which motivate extensions beyond $Λ$CDM, including interacting dark energy (IDE). Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) are precise probes of the late-time expansion history, while gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) can extend distance measurements to higher redshifts. However, GRB cosmology depends on the calibration of luminosity relations, the covariance treatment, and the intrinsic scatter. In this work, we use 15 years of Fermi/GBM long-GRB observations and Pantheon+ SNe Ia to test whether current distance data provide evidence in favor of IDE models over $Λ$CDM. We compare four flat models: $Λ$CDM, $w$CDM, IDE-$ρ_{\rm de}$, and IDE-$ρ_{\rm c}$. The GRB covariance is constructed by propagating the Amati-relation calibration covariance, and the GRB intrinsic scatter is sampled as a nuisance parameter. A diagonal GRB covariance is also considered as a robustness test. With the full GRB covariance, both the GOLD and FULL samples give $H_0\simeq 72.8~{\rm km~s^{-1}~Mpc^{-1}}$ in $Λ$CDM. The IDE models do not improve the fit enough to compensate for their extra parameters, and the BIC favors the simpler $Λ$CDM model. The diagonal-covariance test gives the same model-selection conclusion, although it changes the fitted GRB intrinsic scatter. We conclude that, for the two interaction forms considered here and at the present level of GRB systematics, current GRB and Pantheon+ data do not provide evidence for interacting dark energy. Current GRBs mainly provide a high-redshift extension of the Hubble diagram and test the shape of the expansion history.

analysis.title_zh: 使用完整 GRB 协方差的 Fermi 伽马暴与 Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星对相互作用暗能量的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 15 年 Fermi/GBM 长 GRB 与 Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星距离数据，比较 ΛCDM、wCDM 及两类相互作用暗能量模型。摘要报告，在传播 Amati 关系校准协方差并采样 GRB 内禀散布后，IDE 模型未能以拟合改善抵消额外参数，BIC 偏好更简单的 ΛCDM。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接使用 CMB，但与 CMB 宇宙学的晚期扩展检验相关：GRB 和超新星给出高红移哈勃图，可作为 CMB 推断的晚期膨胀历史交叉检查。摘要中的结论意味着，在当前 GRB 系统误差水平下，这类距离数据尚不足以支持通过相互作用暗能量来缓解 H0 张力或改变标准模型解释。
key_points: 用 Fermi/GBM 长暴和 Pantheon+ 超新星检验相互作用暗能量。
显式传播 Amati 关系校准协方差，并采样 GRB 内禀散布。
摘要结论是当前 GRB+SNe 数据未给出支持 IDE 优于 ΛCDM 的证据。
methods: 15 年 Fermi/GBM 长伽马暴观测
Amati 关系校准协方差传播
GRB 内禀散布作为 nuisance 参数采样
对角 GRB 协方差稳健性测试

papers.title: Decaying Dark Matter as a Possible Solution for Cosmological Tensions
papers.abstract: Large-scale structure measurements have revealed persistent tensions between early- and late-time cosmological probes, most notably the long-standing discrepancy in the structure-growth parameter $S_8$. In this work, we explore how a model including decaying dark matter (DDM) can alleviate this tension by suppressing the growth of matter fluctuations at late times. Specifically, we consider a neutrinophilic decay channel in which a heavy dark matter particle $χ$ slowly decays into a Standard Model neutrino and a light invisible fermion, $χ\rightarrow ν+ φ$, modifying both the background evolution and the clustering of structure. Using the DES Year~1 redshift distributions, we construct a baseline matter power spectrum and compute the galaxy-galaxy, shear-shear, and galaxy-shear angular power spectra under both $Λ$CDM and DDM-inspired scenarios. We find that slow dark matter decay produces a scale-dependent suppression of clustering that remains consistent with DES measurements while naturally shifting the predicted structure amplitude toward the lower values favored by weak lensing surveys. Our results suggest that decaying dark matter is a compelling and physically motivated framework for addressing the $S_8$ tension.

analysis.title_zh: 衰变暗物质作为宇宙学张力的一种可能解
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究衰变暗物质是否能缓解早期与晚期宇宙学探针之间的结构增长张力，特别是 S8 张力。作者采用亲中微子衰变道 χ→ν+φ，并用 DES Year 1 红移分布计算 ΛCDM 与衰变暗物质情景下的物质功率谱和三类角功率谱；摘要报告慢衰变会产生尺度依赖的聚类抑制，并使结构振幅更接近弱透镜巡天偏好的较低值。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: S8 张力直接连接 CMB 推断的早期宇宙参数与低红移弱透镜/大尺度结构观测。若暗物质在晚期衰变，它会改变从 CMB 初始条件演化到今日结构的增长历史，因此是检验 ΛCDM 外物理、解释 CMB 与低红移结构不一致的重要候选机制。
key_points: 慢衰变暗物质可在晚期抑制物质涨落增长。
摘要关注 DES Year 1 的星系聚类、弱透镜剪切及其互相关角功率谱。
结果声称该机制在保持与 DES 测量一致的同时，将结构振幅推向弱透镜偏好的较低值。
methods: 衰变暗物质模型：重暗物质粒子 χ 衰变为标准模型中微子和轻不可见费米子 φ，χ→ν+φ
星系-星系、剪切-剪切、星系-剪切角功率谱计算
ΛCDM 与 DDM-inspired 情景比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对衰变寿命、分支道和能量注入如何进入背景与扰动方程，以及与 DES 协方差、尺度切割和重子/非线性建模的相容性是否足以支撑“缓解 S8 张力”的表述。

papers.title: The sound of dynamical dark energy and modified gravity
papers.abstract: Different candidate models are able to reproduce the dynamical dark energy signal preferred by combinations of recent distance measurements. These models may be distinguished by the behavior of their perturbations, which are controlled by the effective sound speed $c_s^2(k,a)$. To explore correlations between the dark energy sound speed and perturbative behavior, we test modified gravity (MG) scenarios in which the dark energy equation of state and sound speed determine modifications to the clustering of matter. We investigate the impact of varying the dark energy sound speed on several cosmological quantities in both General Relativity (GR) and MG. We constrain the dark energy and modified gravity parameters using measurements of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) from Planck PR4, type Ia supernova luminosity distances (SN) from Pantheon+, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) from DESI DR2, and cosmic shear from DES-Y3. Using the combination of CMB+BAO+SN, we find that, in the MG scenarios, the preference for dynamical dark energy is correlated with deviations from GR over redshifts $z < 2$ at over 95\% confidence level. The significance of these deviations is not degraded when considering a dynamical or superluminal sound speed, but vanishes if we assume a cosmological constant. The inclusion of cosmic shear and CMB lensing data significantly shifts the constraints towards GR. Our framework enables the exploration of modified gravity models using the dark energy sound speed as a physically meaningful free parameter.

analysis.title_zh: 动力学暗能量与修正引力之声
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究动力学暗能量和修正引力模型中，暗能量有效声速 c_s^2(k,a) 如何影响扰动和物质聚类，并用 CMB、超新星、BAO 与 cosmic shear 数据约束相关参数。摘要报告，在 CMB+BAO+SN 组合下，MG 情景中动力学暗能量偏好与 z<2 的 GR 偏离在超过 95% 置信水平上相关；但加入 cosmic shear 和 CMB lensing 后，约束显著移向 GR。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接使用 Planck PR4 CMB 和 CMB lensing，并讨论暗能量/修正引力扰动如何影响物质聚类和低红移增长。对 CMB 研究者而言，它关系到如何把 CMB 距离标尺、透镜信号与 DESI、超新星、弱透镜联合起来检验 ΛCDM、动力学暗能量和 GR。
key_points: 暗能量声速被作为区分动力学暗能量和修正引力扰动行为的自由参数。
数据组合包括 Planck PR4 CMB、Pantheon+、DESI DR2 BAO、DES-Y3 cosmic shear，并讨论 CMB lensing。
摘要称 CMB+BAO+SN 下 MG 情景中动力学暗能量偏好与 z<2 的 GR 偏离相关；加入 cosmic shear 和 CMB lensing 后约束显著转向 GR。
methods: 有效声速 c_s^2(k,a) 参数化
广义相对论与修正引力情景比较
Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星光度距离
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 MG 参数化与暗能量声速之间的物理一致性、先验选择，以及 CMB lensing 和 cosmic shear 加入后为何把约束推向 GR，是否由数据张力、系统误差处理或参数退化驱动。

papers.title: Late-time Quantum Vacuum Decay and its Cosmological Implications
papers.abstract: The existence of a landscape of metastable vacua raises the possibility that our Universe may have undergone quantum vacuum decay at late times. This work explores how such a transition can be tested with cosmological observables, focusing on precision distance measurements and cosmic microwave background (CMB) anisotropies. A set of phenomenological models is constructed in which late-time quantum tunneling changes the vacuum energy and may convert a subcomponent of dark matter into dark radiation, possibly accompanied by domain-wall production. The resulting expansion histories are compared with DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation data; supernova distance measurements from DES-Dovekie, Pantheon+, and Union3; and a compressed CMB likelihood. For quantum-tunneling models, current cosmological distance measurements still allow a 50% decrease in the total vacuum energy for a transition redshift $z_t<1$. The model with dark-matter conversion and domain-wall production provides a good fit to resolve the tension between cosmological observables and the $Λ$CDM model, with a preferred transition around $z_t \sim 7$ and about 10% of dark matter participating in the transition. Additionally, CMB anisotropy constraints from bubble nucleation and the associated domain-wall network are derived and shown to strongly restrict slow or sparse late transitions. Applied to the minimal quantum-tunneling model, these constraints allow an $\mathcal{O}(10\%)$ decrease in the total vacuum energy for a transition redshift $z_t$ of order unity. For nonminimal models, dark-matter-density-dependent tunneling can proceed rapidly enough to evade such bounds. These results demonstrate that late-time quantum vacuum decay is a testable cosmological phenomenon and provide a concrete observational handle on metastable-vacuum physics motivated by landscape scenarios.

analysis.title_zh: 晚期量子真空衰变及其宇宙学影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文探讨晚期量子真空衰变是否可通过宇宙学观测检验，构建了真空能改变、暗物质部分转化为暗辐射及可能产生畴壁的唯象模型，并与 BAO、超新星距离和压缩 CMB 似然比较。摘要报告，当前距离测量仍允许低红移转变中总真空能显著下降；包含暗物质转化和畴壁的模型可较好拟合 ΛCDM 相关张力，同时 CMB 各向异性对缓慢或稀疏晚期转变给出强限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 晚期真空能变化会改变 CMB 锚定后的距离-红移关系，而泡成核和畴壁网络还可能直接产生或调制 CMB 各向异性。该工作把精密距离探针与 CMB 各向异性约束结合，用来测试超出 ΛCDM 的真空结构和暗部门相变。
key_points: 晚期量子真空隧穿被建模为真空能变化，并可能伴随暗物质转化为暗辐射和畴壁产生。
作者使用 DESI DR2 BAO、多套超新星距离数据和压缩 CMB 似然检验膨胀历史。
摘要还给出来自泡成核和畴壁网络的 CMB 各向异性约束，称其强烈限制缓慢或稀疏的晚期相变。
methods: 晚期量子隧穿的唯象模型
暗物质向暗辐射转化模型
畴壁产生与泡成核相关 CMB 各向异性约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对压缩 CMB 似然是否足以代表完整 CMB 约束、泡成核/畴壁网络对各向异性的计算假设，以及关于 z_t、真空能下降比例和暗物质参与比例的偏好是否依赖特定先验或数据组合。

papers.title: A Designer's Guide to Lunar Far-Side Interferometer Array: Power Spectrum Measurement and Cosmological Constraints from the Dark Ages
papers.abstract: The 21-cm emission line from neutral hydrogen during the cosmic Dark Ages can be a powerful probe of cosmological models and early universe physics. This work provides a quantitative forecast for the design requirements of a lunar far-side interferometer array aimed at measuring the 21-cm power spectrum and constraining inflationary models through the running of the spectral index $α_s$. During the Dark Ages, larger collapsed objects have not yet formed, allowing linear perturbation theory to remain valid down to much smaller scales than is possible in current large-scale structure or CMB surveys. We first validate this linearity assumption by quantifying the contribution of minihalos to the 21-cm signal. We then establish a generalized and flexible analytical framework for the baseline density distribution of interferometers that may consist of an arbitrary number of stations or sub-arrays. Incorporating a realistic noise model, we determine the configurations necessary to reach the detection threshold and demonstrate that distributing the total collecting area into multiple stations can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the power spectrum at a tunable small scale of interest by up to two orders of magnitude. We then show that a lunar array requires at least $\sim30,000$ probed Fourier modes to achieve a constraint on inflation of $σ(α_s) = 0.034$, a result competitive with the Planck 2018 results and capable of distinguishing between different inflationary scenarios. We quantitatively explain how thermal noise severely erodes modes at high redshifts and small scales -- scales previously considered easily accessible to Dark Ages observations in the literature -- and discuss the prospects for Dark Ages observations as a new and independent probe despite this limitation.

analysis.title_zh: 月球背面干涉阵列设计指南：来自暗时代的功率谱测量与宇宙学约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对月球背面干涉阵观测宇宙暗时代中性氢 21-cm 功率谱，建立阵列基线密度和噪声的解析预报框架，并用谱指数跑动 α_s 评估暴胀约束能力。摘要报告称，多站点配置可在目标小尺度提高功率谱信噪比，达到与 Planck 2018 结果有竞争力的 α_s 约束需要至少约 30,000 个被探测 Fourier 模，同时热噪声会显著侵蚀高红移小尺度信息。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗时代 21-cm 信号可探测比当前 CMB 和大尺度结构更小的线性尺度，因此能独立检验原初扰动和暴胀模型；对 CMB 读者而言，这篇工作直接比较了 α_s 约束与 Planck 2018，并强调未来低频阵列设计和热噪声会决定其是否真正补充 CMB。
key_points: 面向月球背面干涉阵的暗时代 21-cm 功率谱观测设计做定量预报。
摘要称多站点分配总收集面积可在可调小尺度上显著提高功率谱信噪比。
指出热噪声会严重削弱高红移和小尺度模，限制以往认为容易进入的暗时代尺度。
methods: 暗时代中性氢 21-cm 功率谱预报
线性微扰理论适用性检验
minihalo 对 21-cm 信号贡献的定量估计
任意站点或子阵列数目的基线密度分布解析框架
用谱指数跑动 α_s 约束暴胀模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对热噪声模型、基线密度参数化和“至少约 30,000 个 Fourier 模”到 σ(α_s)=0.034 的 Fisher/似然假设；还要检查 minihalo 贡献是否足以支撑线性理论在目标小尺度上的使用。

papers.title: Dynamical Tsallis WIMP Freeze-Out and Residual Memory Channels in the Radiation Sector
papers.abstract: In this work we generalize the thermal decoupling, or freeze-out, of weakly interacting massive particle dark matter within the Tsallis nonextensive formalism. The generalization is implemented through $q$-deformed distribution functions obtained from the maximum entropy principle with Curado-Tsallis constraints. The Tsallis parameter $q$, which measures deviations from extensivity with respect to the limit $q=1$, is promoted to a dynamical quantity depending on the dimensionless variable $x=m_χ/T$, where $m_χ$ is the dark matter mass. This dynamical evolution is characterized by a relaxation toward extensivity, while requiring that the nonextensive deformation is not completely erased before freeze-out. We solve the Boltzmann equation assuming a sectorial deformation, where only the dark matter equilibrium abundance is generalized and the radiation background remains extensive. The relic abundance is computed for different dark matter masses and initial values of the Tsallis parameter. From this evolution, we extract the residual value $q_χ^{\rm fo}$ at freeze-out, which is then used as the initial input for a phenomenological memory channel. This channel propagates the residual nonextensivity into the radiation sector, specifically into the electron-positron plasma and neutrinos, while photons are kept extensive in order to avoid direct tensions with CMB physics. The resulting deformation modifies the neutrino energy density and the photon reheating contribution, producing a correction to $N_{\rm eff}$. We compare the predicted values with the compressed CMB+BAO constraint on $N_{\rm eff}$ and find that the residual-memory scenario can remain phenomenologically compatible with current bounds.

analysis.title_zh: 动态 Tsallis WIMP 冻结与辐射部门中的残余记忆通道
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 Tsallis 非广延统计框架中推广 WIMP 暗物质冻结，令非广延参数 q 随 x=mχ/T 动态趋向广延极限，并通过 Boltzmann 方程计算遗迹丰度。摘要称冻结时残余的非广延性可经现象学记忆通道传入电子-正电子等离子体和中微子，修正 N_eff，且与当前压缩 CMB+BAO 约束保持现象学相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对有效中微子数 N_eff 和辐射能量密度极为敏感，因此任何暗物质冻结历史向辐射部门传递的非标准效应都可能留下可观测痕迹；这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要在于用 N_eff 作为连接粒子暗物理和 CMB+BAO 数据的桥梁。
key_points: 将 WIMP 热退耦推广到动态 Tsallis 非广延形式。
非广延残余通过现象学“记忆通道”影响电子-正电子等离子体和中微子。
摘要称预测的 N_eff 修正可与压缩的 CMB+BAO 约束相容。
methods: Curado-Tsallis 约束下最大熵原理得到的 q 变形分布函数
令 Tsallis 参数 q 随 x=mχ/T 动态演化
部门化变形：仅推广暗物质平衡丰度，辐射背景保持广延
与压缩 CMB+BAO 的 N_eff 约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 q(x) 的动力学设定是否有微观依据、只让暗物质丰度变形而保持光子广延的处理是否自洽，以及 N_eff 修正与 CMB+BAO 约束比较中采用的压缩似然是否足以代表完整数据限制。

papers.title: Measuring the Hubble constant with strongly lensed gravitational waves from space-based detector networks
papers.abstract: The measurement of the Hubble constant $H_0$ plays a central role in modern cosmology. In this work, we investigate the potential of strongly lensed gravitational-wave (SLGW) signals from massive binary black hole mergers to constrain $H_0$ using future space-based detector networks. We consider two observational scenarios: one in which the source redshift is unknown, and another in which it is independently determined through electromagnetic observations. We show that meaningful constraints on $H_0$ can still be achieved without source-redshift information, provided that the lens redshift is known. For individual SLGW events, the joint Taiji+LISA analysis improves the measurement precision of $H_0$ by approximately a factor of two compared with the Taiji-only configuration. Extending the analysis to the population level, we combine five simulated SLGW events and find that the uncertainty in $H_0$, quantified by the 95\% credible interval, reaches the $1.1\times10^{-1}$ level when the source redshift is treated as unknown, and further improves to $4.2\times10^{-2}$ when the source redshift is independently measured. Our results demonstrate that joint space-based gravitational-wave observations can substantially enhance the cosmological capability of SLGW events and provide a promising avenue for precision measurements of the Hubble constant.

analysis.title_zh: 利用空间探测器网络观测的强透镜引力波测量哈勃常数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评估未来空间引力波探测器网络利用大质量双黑洞并合的强透镜引力波信号约束 H0 的能力，并比较源红移未知与由电磁观测独立测定两种场景。摘要报告称，只要透镜红移已知，即使源红移未知也能得到有意义的 H0 约束，Taiji+LISA 联合优于 Taiji 单独，五个模拟事件合并可进一步降低不确定度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 是 CMB 推断宇宙学与近邻宇宙测量之间张力的核心参数；强透镜引力波提供一种独立于 CMB 声学尺度和传统距离梯的测量路径，可作为检验 ΛCDM 或系统误差的重要外部交叉检查。
key_points: 研究空间引力波探测器网络用强透镜引力波测量 H0。
比较源红移未知和电磁观测给出源红移两种情形。
摘要称 Taiji+LISA 相比 Taiji 单独可提高单事件 H0 精度，并在五个模拟事件合并后进一步收紧约束。
methods: 大质量双黑洞并合模拟
未来空间探测器网络 Taiji 与 LISA
源红移未知和源红移由电磁观测独立测定两种情景
五个模拟 SLGW 事件的总体合并分析
95% credible interval 表征 H0 不确定度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对强透镜系统的质量模型、镜像识别和时延误差如何进入 H0 后验；还要检查源红移未知时仅依赖透镜红移获得 H0 约束的先验设定及五个模拟事件是否具有代表性。

papers.title: GINKAKU: Scalable Cosmological Structure Formation Simulation Code and Post-processing Pipeline
papers.abstract: We introduce GINKAKU, a new cosmological $N$-body code developed for the Dark Quest II (DQ2) simulation campaign and designed for controlled ensemble production across the cosmological model space required by next-generation galaxy surveys, including massive neutrinos and clustering dark energy. Built on the FDPS framework, GINKAKU couples a TreePM gravity solver with a linear-response treatment of external source terms for components not evolved as $N$-body particles, formulated in the $N$-body gauge. This design incorporates massive-neutrino perturbations, general-relativistic corrections, early-time radiation perturbations, and dark-energy clustering with non-unit effective sound speed at the linear level, while preserving Newtonian particle dynamics on subhorizon scales. The code is validated through internal convergence studies and cross-comparisons with GADGET, PKDGRAV3, and RAMSES on shared initial conditions: code-to-code differences in the nonlinear power spectrum can be reduced below $\sim1\%$ level by tuning internal accuracy parameters, and we identify a production-grade fiducial setting achieving this control at modest cost. We apply GINKAKU to an initial set of DQ2 production runs -- eight cosmological models with $3,000^3$ particles in boxes up to $4\,h^{-1}\mathrm{Gpc}$ -- processed by a renewed post-processing pipeline that reduces the inter-resolution spread of the halo mass function to $\sim 1\%$ and includes halo-shape measurements for intrinsic-alignment statistics. The scale-dependent-growth cosmologies reproduce the expected nonlinear signatures of massive neutrinos and clustering dark energy, demonstrating suitability for emulator-scale production. A total matter power spectrum emulator from these runs is presented in an accompanying paper. (abridged)

analysis.title_zh: GINKAKU：可扩展的宇宙学结构形成模拟代码与后处理管线
analysis.summary_zh: 该文介绍 GINKAKU，一个为 Dark Quest II 模拟计划开发的可扩展宇宙学 N 体代码及后处理流程，用于覆盖含大质量中微子和聚团暗能量的宇宙学模型空间。摘要报告其采用 TreePM 与线性响应外源项处理，并通过收敛测试和与 GADGET、PKDGRAV3、RAMSES 的比较验证，在调节精度参数后非线性功率谱代码间差异可降至约 1% 水平，且已用于首批 DQ2 生产模拟。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 约束常需与低红移大尺度结构、弱透镜和星系巡天联合解释，而这些分析依赖对非线性物质功率谱、晕统计及含中微子/暗能量模型的精确模拟。GINKAKU 若能稳定支撑仿真器级生产，将直接影响 CMB+LSS 联合约束中对小尺度非线性、暗能量聚团和中微子质量效应的建模误差。
key_points: 介绍面向 Dark Quest II 的新宇宙学 N 体模拟代码与后处理流程。
在线性层面纳入大质量中微子、相对论修正、早期辐射扰动和聚团暗能量等外源项。
摘要称与多种代码交叉比较后可将非线性功率谱差异控制到约 1% 水平，并已用于 DQ2 初始生产运行。
methods: N-body gauge 中的线性响应外源项处理
与 GADGET、PKDGRAV3、RAMSES 在共享初始条件上的交叉比较
Dark Quest II 生产运行
更新的后处理管线、晕质量函数与晕形状测量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对线性响应外源项与牛顿粒子动力学的耦合形式、N-body gauge 实现细节、精度参数调节是否会影响不同宇宙学模型上的稳健性，以及 1% 级功率谱和晕质量函数控制的适用尺度与质量范围。

papers.title: Gaussian Process Reconstruction of Cosmological Parameters with Gravitational Wave Sirens using Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Future gravitational wave (GW) standard siren catalogues will probe the late-time expansion history of the Universe across redshift ranges largely inaccessible to traditional electromagnetic observations. To determine how effectively this background distance information can distinguish between viable cosmological models, we introduce a model-independent reconstruction framework utilizing Gaussian Process Regression (GPR). Analyzing mock LISA and Einstein Telescope (ET) catalogues across six fiducial cosmological backgrounds-$Λ$CDM, CPL, CPL+$Λ$, interacting dark matter, interacting dark energy and axion inspired early dark energy. We reconstruct the comoving distance and its derivatives. Crucially, we propagated the full GP covariance, including derivative cross-covariances, to robustly evaluate the Hubble parameter $H(z)$ and other diagnostics such as $q(z)$, $\mathcal{O}_{m}(z)$ $w_{\rm total}(z)$ and $κ(z)$. While our analysis demonstrates that GW bright standard sirens faithfully recover fiducial expansion histories, applying pointwise marginal Hellinger distance reveals that background measurements alone do not provide decisive statistical separation among models. Instead, derivative sensitive diagnostics pinpoint specific redshift windows (e.g., $z\simeq1.6-1.8$ for ET and $z\simeq2.6-2.9$ for LISA) where future catalogues will maximize their discriminatory power. As machine learning methodologies become increasingly integral to astrophysics and cosmology, this Bayesian GPR pipeline offers a principled, nonparametric approach to precisely identifying where the most valuable cosmological information lies.

analysis.title_zh: 利用机器学习和引力波标准汽笛对宇宙学参数进行高斯过程重建
analysis.summary_zh: 该文提出用高斯过程回归对未来引力波亮标准汽笛目录进行模型无关的宇宙学参数与距离导数重建，测试模拟 LISA 和 Einstein Telescope 数据在六种基准宇宙学背景下的表现。摘要报告标准汽笛可恢复基准膨胀历史，但仅靠背景距离测量不能在模型间给出决定性统计区分，导数敏感诊断则指出了最具判别力的红移区间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作主要面向晚期宇宙膨胀史的独立测量，可作为 CMB 推断的低红移互补检验，尤其有助于检查暗能量、相互作用暗物质/暗能量和早期暗能量模型与 CMB 所给早期宇宙约束之间的一致性。不过摘要未涉及 CMB 数据联合分析，因此对 CMB 读者更偏方法和外部探针参考。
key_points: 提出用高斯过程回归重建引力波标准汽笛的背景距离信息。
分析模拟 LISA 和 Einstein Telescope 目录下六类基准宇宙学背景。
摘要称背景距离本身难以给出模型间决定性区分，但导数敏感诊断可定位更有判别力的红移窗口。
methods: 模拟 LISA 标准汽笛目录
模拟 Einstein Telescope 标准汽笛目录
协动距离及其导数重建
传播完整 GP 协方差和导数交叉协方差
Hubble 参数 H(z)、q(z)、Om(z)、w_total(z)、κ(z) 诊断
逐点边际 Hellinger 距离
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟标准汽笛目录的误差模型和选择函数、GP 核函数与超参数处理、导数重建中协方差传播是否充分，以及 Hellinger 距离被如何解释为模型区分能力。

papers.title: GWTC-5.0: Constraints on the Cosmic Expansion Rate and Modified Gravitational-wave Propagation
authors: J. F. J. van den Brand
papers.abstract: We employ 236 gravitational-wave (GW) sources in the fifth LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA Collaboration (LVK) Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog (GWTC-5.0) to estimate the Hubble constant $H_0$. We compare the luminosity distance measured from GWs to the redshift inferred i) using features in the mass spectrum, and ii) using statistical host galaxy association. Probing the relationship between source luminosity distances and redshifts obtained in this way yields constraints on cosmological parameters. We estimate $H_0 = {71.7}_{-7.5}^{+9.4}\,{\text{km}\,\text{s}^{-1}\,\text{Mpc}^{-1}}$ (median with $68\%$ symmetric credible interval). This combines information from the source-frame mass distribution with the $H_0$ measurement from GW170817 and its electromagnetic counterpart as well as galaxy catalog information from Dark Energy Survey Year 6 (DES-Y6). We improve over the GWTC-4.0 measurement by using more GW sources, some with significantly smaller sky localization volumes, which leads to a reduction by $22.0\%$ of the $H_0$ uncertainty and a reconstructed mass distribution with lower uncertainties. We also constrain deviations from general relativity (GR) which affect GW propagation, specifically that modify the luminosity distance inferred from the GW signal. We find no departures from GR in parameterized tests of GW propagation.

papers.title: Constraints on Dynamical Dark Energy from Multiple Probes in the Full Dark Energy Survey
papers.abstract: We present results on dark energy evolution, assuming a time-dependent equation of state $w(a)=w_0+w_a(1-a)$, from growth and geometric probes using the full six-year Dark Energy Survey dataset: type Ia supernovae, baryon acoustic oscillations, and weak gravitational lensing and galaxy clustering (3$\times$2pt). The combination yields $w_0=-0.84^{+0.10}_{-0.10}$ and $w_a=-0.44^{+0.60}_{-0.55}$, the tightest constraints ever obtained from a single survey, with $2.2σ$ deviation from a cosmological constant. Adding the DESI DR2 BAO data yields $w_0=-0.84^{+0.06}_{-0.07}$ and $w_a=-0.53^{+0.33}_{-0.28}$, representing the most stringent low-redshift-only test of dynamical dark energy to date, with a $2.3σ$ deviation. In this combination, adding 3$\times$2pt doubles the constraining power. Finally, when combined with primary CMB information, we obtain $w_0=-0.82^{+0.05}_{-0.05}$, $w_a=-0.63^{+0.21}_{-0.18}$, with a $3.0σ$ deviation. We find that including 3$\times$2pt in the previously studied SN + DESI BAO + CMB combination leaves the significance essentially unchanged ($3.2 σ$ to $3.0σ$) while improving the figure of merit by $\sim$10\%. We systematically investigate the impact of leaving out each one of the probes and find that the significance of the deviation from a cosmological constant ranges from 2.3 to 3.2$σ$, with best-fit parameters consistently in the region $w_0 >-1$ and $w_a <0$. Excluding SN from the all data combination yields a $2.6σ$ departure from $Λ$CDM, providing a cross-check independent of supernova photometric calibration. These results support the weak preference for evolving dark energy reported by several recent cosmological analyses. By combining growth and geometric probes from a single survey, this work realizes the multi-probe dark energy program envisioned at the inception of DES.

analysis.title_zh: 利用完整暗能量巡天的多探针对动态暗能量的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 该文用完整六年 Dark Energy Survey 的 Ia 型超新星、BAO、弱透镜和星系聚类 3×2pt，在 CPL 参数化下约束动态暗能量，并进一步加入 DESI DR2 BAO 与 primary CMB 信息。摘要报告各组合给出对宇宙学常数的约 2.2σ 至 3.0σ 弱偏离，最佳拟合倾向于 w0>-1、wa<0，且 3×2pt 可提升低红移组合的约束力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是直接涉及 CMB 联合约束的暗能量结果：primary CMB 提供早期宇宙锚点，而 DES 与 DESI 的低红移几何和增长探针检验从 CMB 外推到晚期宇宙的 ΛCDM 是否一致。对研究 CMB 的读者而言，关键在于理解 CMB 与低红移探针联合后动态暗能量偏好如何形成，以及它是否反映真实物理、系统误差或数据组合张力。
key_points: 使用完整六年 DES 数据的超新星、BAO、弱透镜和星系聚类 3×2pt 约束 CPL 动态暗能量。
摘要报告单一巡天组合、加入 DESI DR2 BAO、再加入 primary CMB 后均得到对 ΛCDM 的弱偏离。
3×2pt 在低红移组合中显著提升约束力，但在已含 SN+DESI BAO+CMB 的组合中主要改善 figure of merit，对偏离显著性影响很小。
methods: 逐一剔除探针的系统检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 primary CMB 数据的具体选择和似然实现、DES 各探针之间的协方差与系统误差处理、3×2pt 与 BAO/SN/CMB 联合时的参数退化方向，以及报告的 ΛCDM 偏离显著性是否受先验、数据组合和张力处理影响。

papers.title: Unveiling the dark matter nature with reionization relics
papers.abstract: Dark matter constitutes roughly one-fourth of the Universe, yet its physical nature remains unknown. Warm dark matter (WDM), a class of dark matter candidates, has non-negligible velocity dispersion that suppresses the formation of small-scale cosmic structures. Current constraints therefore rely mainly on small-scale probes such as the Lyman-alpha (Ly$α$) forest and Milky Way observations of satellite galaxies and stellar streams. We propose a novel large-scale probe based on long-lived "reionization relics": because the thermal and dynamical evolution of the intergalactic medium depends on the local reionization redshift, patchy reionization imprints additional large-scale fluctuations in Ly$α$ forest opacity and post-reionization HI traced by 21 cm intensity mapping. The strength of these imprints depends on WDM through both small-scale gas evolution and WDM-driven changes in the reionization history. For example, the Ly$α$ (21 cm) power spectrum in 3 keV WDM differs from cold dark matter by ~19% (~19%) at $k=0.05\,{\rm Mpc^{-1}}$ at z=4 (z=5.5) when reionization relics are included. Using Ly$α$ forest with a covariance model designed to mimic the capabilities of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), we forecast a constraint of $m_{\rm WDM}>5.0\,{\rm keV}$ (95%), which improves to $m_{\rm WDM}>7.1\,{\rm keV}$ when combined with 21 cm intensity-mapping observations from the Square Kilometre Array (SKA). The next-generation surveys can further strengthen the current best lower bounds from 9.7 to 39 keV.

analysis.title_zh: 用再电离遗迹揭示暗物质的性质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出利用长寿命“再电离遗迹”来约束温暗物质：斑块状再电离会在 Lyα 森林不透明度和后再电离 HI 的 21 cm 强度映射中留下大尺度涨落。摘要报告，在纳入这些遗迹后，3 keV 温暗物质相对冷暗物质可在特定红移和尺度上改变 Lyα 与 21 cm 功率谱，并用 DESI 类 Lyα 与 SKA 21 cm 预测得到更强的温暗物质质量下限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作把暗物质微观性质、再电离历史和大尺度结构观测联系起来；虽然不是直接 CMB 分析，但再电离是 CMB 光学深度、kSZ 以及高红移结构形成解释中的核心环节，因此其模型假设会影响 CMB 与 Lyα/21 cm 联合宇宙学推断。
key_points: 提出用再电离遗迹作为温暗物质的大尺度探针。
斑块状再电离会影响 Lyα 森林不透明度和后再电离 HI 的 21 cm 强度映射。
摘要给出基于 DESI 类 Lyα 协方差模型与 SKA 21 cm 组合的温暗物质质量约束预测。
methods: DESI 能力模拟的协方差模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对再电离遗迹的建模假设、WDM 对再电离历史和小尺度气体演化的分解方式，以及 DESI/SKA 预测协方差是否包含关键系统误差和天体物理退化。

papers.title: Unifying Early and Late Dark Energy: Dynamical Requirements and Obstructions
papers.abstract: We investigate whether early- and late-time dark energy could arise from a single scalar field. Adopting a bottom-up perspective, we first identify the sequence of dynamical regimes that any unified scenario must traverse to account for both an early dark energy phase relevant for pre-recombination solutions of the Hubble tension and the late-time acceleration of the Universe. We derive the corresponding requirements on the scalar energy density and equation of state. We then adopt a complementary top-down perspective and translate these requirements into constraints on the phase-space structure of minimally coupled scalar fields with tracking-like dynamics. We show that satisfying all requirements necessitates a potential with three distinct slopes, arranged in a steep-steeper-shallow hierarchy. This conclusion remains unchanged in the presence of conformal couplings to dark matter. These results place strong constraints on attempts to construct unified models of early- and late-time dark energy. We discuss implications for model-building.

analysis.title_zh: 统一早期与晚期暗能量：动力学要求与障碍
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察早期暗能量与晚期暗能量是否可由同一个标量场产生，先从现象学角度列出统一模型必须经历的动力学阶段，再从标量场相空间结构反推势能要求。摘要报告，满足所有要求需要具有三个不同斜率、呈“陡-更陡-浅”层级的势能，即使加入与暗物质的共形耦合也不改变该结论。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 早期暗能量常被用作缓解 Hubble 张力的 CMB 前复合方案，晚期暗能量则控制低红移距离和增长历史；该文为把二者统一到单一场中的模型构建设置了动力学约束，有助于判断哪些扩展 ΛCDM 模型值得进入 CMB 与低红移数据拟合。
key_points: 研究单一标量场能否同时解释早期暗能量和晚期加速。
从动力学阶段需求和相空间结构两条路径推导限制。
摘要称所需势能必须具有三个不同斜率，且暗物质共形耦合不改变这一结论。
methods: 自下而上的动力学阶段分析
标量场能量密度与状态方程需求推导
极小耦合标量场的相空间结构分析
暗物质共形耦合情形讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“陡-更陡-浅”三斜率势能层级的推导是否依赖特定相空间假设，以及这些动力学条件对 CMB 前复合早期暗能量窗口的适用范围。

papers.title: Early- and Late-Time Modifications to $Λ$CDM: Implications for the Hubble Tension
papers.abstract: We investigate an extension of $Λ$CDM in which a fraction of cold Dark Matter (DM) decays into invisible dark radiation (DR) around the radiation-matter equality epoch, together with a non-standard dark energy (DE) equation of state characterized by $w_0$. The decaying DM component modifies the early expansion history and reduces the sound horizon at baryon drag, while the DE alters the expansion rate at the late times. A comprehensive analysis combining \texttt{Planck 2018+ACT DR6+DESI DR2+CMB lensing} datasets has been carried out to explore the viability of this framework in addressing the $H_0$ tension. This model yields a Hubble constant of $H_0 = 69.83 \pm 0.98~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, reducing the discrepancy with SH0ES measurement to ${\sim}2.2σ$ and local distance network measurement (H0DN) to ${\sim}2.9σ$. Further, considering \texttt{SH0ES} and \texttt{Pantheon+}, the inferred value of the Hubble constant becomes $H_0 = 70.20 \pm 0.66~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$. The Bayesian evidence suggests that this framework offers a fit to the relevant cosmological datasets at a statistically similar level as $Λ$CDM. It is observed that correlated early- and late-time modifications to the cosmological expansion history provide a more effective route to reducing the $H_0$ tension than either class of modification alone.

analysis.title_zh: 对 ΛCDM 的早期与晚期修正：对 Hubble 张力的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一种扩展 ΛCDM：部分冷暗物质在辐射-物质相等时期附近衰变为不可见暗辐射，同时晚期暗能量由 w0 描述，从而同时改变早期声视界和晚期膨胀率。摘要报告，结合 Planck 2018、ACT DR6、DESI DR2 与 CMB lensing 等数据后，该模型给出较高的 H0 并降低与本地测量的张力，但贝叶斯证据显示其拟合水平与 ΛCDM 统计上相似。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇直接使用 CMB 温度/偏振相关数据、ACT 和 CMB 透镜，并通过改变早期膨胀史影响声视界，是 CMB 约束 H0 张力模型的核心问题；同时它检验早期暗部门物理与晚期暗能量组合是否比单独修改更有效。
key_points: 模型同时引入辐射-物质相等时期附近的部分冷暗物质衰变和非常规暗能量状态方程。
使用 Planck 2018、ACT DR6、DESI DR2、CMB lensing 等数据检验 Hubble 张力。
摘要称该框架可降低与 SH0ES 和 H0DN 的差异，但贝叶斯证据显示其总体拟合与 ΛCDM 统计上相近。
methods: 含暗辐射的衰变暗物质模型
以 w0 表征的暗能量状态方程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对参数先验、数据组合顺序、CMB lensing 与 BAO 对早期衰变暗物质的约束如何打破退化，以及贝叶斯证据“与 ΛCDM 相近”是否足以支持该扩展模型。

papers.title: Polarized Anisotropic Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background Search with Ground-Based Detector Networks
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves admit a Stokes decomposition into intensity ($I$), circular polarization ($V$), and linear polarization ($Q$, $U$), analogous to Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) polarimetry. We implement a full-Stokes maximum-likelihood SGWB map-making analysis for ground-based detector networks, promoting the standard cross-correlation data products used in existing pipelines to a joint reconstruction of $I$, $V$, $Q$, $U$. Applied to LVK O3 data, we constrain the polarized angular spectra $C^{VV}_\ell$, $C^{EE}_\ell$, $C^{BB}_\ell$ and $|C^{IV}_\ell|$. We show that an intensity-only model is biased when polarized sky components are present, since the detector-network Fisher inner product does not generally make the Stokes responses orthogonal. For transient CBC foregrounds, polarized shot noise is not parametrically suppressed relative to ordinary CBC intensity shot noise. The full Stokes framework separates the Stokes sectors while providing access to polarized anisotropies invisible to conventional intensity-only searches.

papers.title: Constraining the Potential Index $n$ of the Early Dark Energy Model Using Cosmic Birefringence from Planck and ACT
papers.abstract: Cosmic birefringence and the Hubble tension represent compelling challenges to the standard $Λ$CDM model. The early dark energy (EDE) model with potentials $V(φ) \propto [1-\cos(φ/f)]^n$ offer a unified framework to address both anomalies through energy injection near matter-radiation equality and parity-violating Chern--Simons coupling to photons. While previous studies have focused on $n=3$, the dependence of the birefringence signal on the potential index $n$ remains largely unexplored. We perform a comprehensive statistical analysis of axion-like EDE models with $n=2$, $n=3$, and $n=\infty$, using $EB$ cross-polarization data from Planck-$EB$ and ACT-$EB$. The $n=2$ model is severely disadvantaged, displaying extreme coupling values ($gM_{\rm pl} \approx 69.912$ for Planck, $-40.726$ for ACT), large $χ^2_{\rm min}$ (144.52 and 86.93), and $Δχ^2<1$ with many local minials. Conversely, $n=3$ achieves the best fits ($χ^2_{\rm min} = 65.70$ and $48.08$) with consistent couplings ($gM_{\rm pl} = -0.210 \pm 0.024$ and $-0.158 \pm 0.025$) that accurately reproduce observations across all angular scales. We checked that the $n=3$ configuration represents the optimal choice for simultaneously addressing the Hubble tension and cosmic birefringence within a theoretically viable framework.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 Planck 和 ACT 的宇宙双折射约束早期暗能量模型的势指数 n
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察轴子样早期暗能量模型中势函数指数 n 如何影响宇宙双折射信号，使用 Planck-EB 和 ACT-EB 数据比较 n=2、n=3 与 n=∞。摘要报告 n=2 拟合表现很差且耦合取值极端，而 n=3 在两个数据集上给出较低 χ²_min 和较一致的耦合参数，被作者认为是同时解释 Hubble tension 与宇宙双折射的优选情形。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙双折射直接涉及 CMB 偏振 EB/TB 相关和偏振角旋转，是检验宇宙学宇称破缺新物理的重要窗口；若与早期暗能量联系起来，还会影响声学尺度、H0 推断以及 ΛCDM 张力的解释。
key_points: 研究轴子样早期暗能量势指数 n 对宇宙双折射信号的影响。
使用 Planck-EB 与 ACT-EB 偏振交叉数据比较 n=2、n=3、n=∞。
摘要称 n=3 给出最佳拟合，并可同时处理 Hubble tension 与 cosmic birefringence。
methods: 轴子样早期暗能量模型 V(φ) ∝ [1-cos(φ/f)]^n
对 n=2、n=3、n=∞ 的统计分析
χ²_min、Δχ² 与耦合参数 gM_pl 拟合比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 EB 数据的系统误差处理、偏振角校准与宇宙双折射信号的退化关系，以及 n=3“最优”结论是否依赖先验、局部极小值处理和 Planck/ACT 数据组合方式。

papers.title: Exploring the Dark Sector: Interacting Radiation in Light of Modern Cosmological Probes
papers.abstract: [abridged] We constrain a phenomenological dark radiation (DR) framework consisting of free-streaming and fluid-like components, providing a model-independent extension of the standard radiation sector. Using Planck CMB data, DESI DR2 BAO measurements, and Pantheon+ and DES Y5 (Dovekie) supernova samples, we derive constraints on additional relativistic degrees of freedom and assess their impact on cosmological tensions. We obtain $N_{\rm fld}<0.66$ (95% C.L.) from CMB data alone, while the combination with BAO yields $N_{\rm fs}=2.93\pm0.23$ and $N_{\rm fld}=0.36^{+0.16}_{-0.21}$ (68% C.L.), consistent with Standard Model expectations for free-streaming radiation. The DR framework significantly alleviates the Hubble tension through an enhanced early-time expansion rate, which reduces the sound horizon scale. The tension with SH0ES is reduced from highly significant in $Λ$CDM to statistically non-significant for CMB+BAO data according to the $\mathcal{T}$-statistic. Bayesian model comparison shows no decisive preference for DR over $Λ$CDM when SH0ES is excluded, with results in the regime of weakly disfavoured. However, including SH0ES data leads to decisive Bayesian evidence in favour of the DR scenario. Overall, DR provides a compelling framework for resolving the Hubble tension. When CMB, BAO, Pantheon$+$ and SH0ES data are considered, we find an increased effective radiation content, $N_{\rm tot}=3.63^{+0.13}_{-0.15}$, with a fraction of free-streaming radiation, $f_{\rm fs}=0.392\pm 0.026$, a reduced sound horizon scale, $r_d = 141.8^{+1.3}_{-1.2}\,\mathrm{Mpc}$, and a higher primordial helium fraction, $Y_{\rm He}=0.2530 \pm 0.0017$, which lies at the level of approximately $\sim 2$-$2.5σ$ above direct determinations from metal-poor H II regions, while remaining broadly consistent with other abundance measurements within current uncertainties.

analysis.title_zh: 探索暗部门：现代宇宙学探针视野下的相互作用辐射
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用含自由流和流体样成分的现象学暗辐射模型扩展标准辐射部门，并联合 Planck CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、超新星及 SH0ES 数据约束额外相对论自由度。摘要报告该框架可通过提高早期膨胀率、减小声视界来缓解 Hubble tension；但在不含 SH0ES 时贝叶斯比较并不决定性支持暗辐射，加入 SH0ES 后则显示对暗辐射情景的强支持。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 额外辐射成分会改变复合前膨胀史、CMB 声峰结构、阻尼尾和声视界标定，因此直接影响 CMB 推断的 H0、BAO 标尺以及 ΛCDM 张力判断，是 CMB 宇宙学中检验早期宇宙新物理的核心方向。
key_points: 构建含自由流与流体样成分的现象学暗辐射框架。
联合 Planck CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、Pantheon+、DES Y5 与 SH0ES 等数据评估 Hubble tension。
摘要称加入 SH0ES 时暗辐射模型获得决定性贝叶斯证据，但不含 SH0ES 时相对 ΛCDM 无决定性偏好。
methods: DES Y5 Dovekie 超新星样本
暗辐射自由流成分 N_fs 与流体样成分 N_fld 参数化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 N_fs、N_fld、N_tot、Y_He 与 r_d 的先验设定和 BBN/丰度约束处理，尤其要区分包含与不包含 SH0ES 时贝叶斯证据和张力缓解结论的稳健性。

papers.title: cloelib: A Flexible Python Library for Computing Cosmological Observables in the Euclid Era
papers.abstract: cloelib is a Python library developed to compute cosmological observables within the Cosmology Likelihood for Observables in Euclid (CLOE) ecosystem (cloe-org). As cosmology enters a precision era driven by galaxy survey missions such as Euclid, there is a growing need for flexible, efficient, and differentiable software capable of supporting next-generation inference pipelines. cloelib addresses these demands through a modular architecture that interfaces seamlessly with established Boltzmann solvers whilst incorporating JAX-based automatic differentiation to enable gradient-based methods. The library defines consistent protocols for background evolution, perturbations, and non-linear structure formation, and supports a wide range of observables, including photometric and spectroscopic large-scale structure probes, as well as cross-correlations with the Cosmic Microwave Background and galaxy clusters. In its finalised form, cloelib is intended to serve as the reference theory computation infrastructure for Euclid's first cosmological release, bridging traditional numerical cosmology with modern optimisation techniques and emerging machine learning approaches to inference.

papers.title: Examining extinction distributions for type Ia supernovae in simulated 3D galaxies
papers.abstract: Dust extinction and reddening greatly contribute to type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) observed color and magnitude variations. The models used to describe the extinction probability density function (PDF) are often simplistic, which can negatively impact SN simulations and cosmology. We present an analysis of simulated SN Ia extinction in galaxies along realistic lines of sight and investigate the parameterization of its PDF, as well as its dependence on host properties. We employed SKIRT, a radiative transfer code, to simulate observations of SNe Ia in different environments and generate synthetic extinction distributions. To parameterize and fit these distributions, we used both the commonly assumed single-parameter exponential PDF and some of its two-parameter generalizations. We find that the standard exponential PDF does not adequately describe simulated SN extinction: It underestimates low-extinction events and overestimates high-extinction ones. 2D KS tests show significant differences between the simulated extinction distributions for SNe in different environments, which the exponential parameterization cannot properly distinguish. In contrast, the two-parameter PDFs parameterize SN extinction distributions more accurately across all simulated environments. Variations in host morphology or dust mass relate to variations in different PDF parameters, meaning that the two effects can effectively be disentangled. We conclude that the two-parameter Weibull or exponentiated exponential PDFs offer the best parameterizations of SN Ia extinction for a wide range of simulated environments. Analyzing observed SN colors from the literature and assuming a Gaussian distribution for the intrinsic component, we conclude that a two-parameter extinction PDF results in intrinsically redder SNe, with their mean intrinsic color shifted ~2$σ$ in relation to the standard exponential extinction PDF.

papers.title: Towards precision cosmology with Void x CMB correlations (II): Impact of mock catalogs on the Void x CMB lensing signal
papers.abstract: Gravitational lensing by large-scale structure imprints secondary anisotropies on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) that can be exploited to probe cosmology. In particular, cosmic voids produce a characteristic lensing signature detectable through Void x CMB cross-correlations. This signal has been robustly measured in the past but its cosmological constraining power remains limited by the incomplete knowledge of how methodological choices affect its measurement and by its uncertain dependence on cosmological parameters. Using a set of validated Roman mock catalogs, we first quantify how mock construction impacts the measured signal and then forecast the capabilities of Roman, in combination with current and upcoming CMB surveys such as Planck, SO and CMB-S4-like experiments. We analyze the signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) for different void definitions (2D and 3D), stacking approaches (rescaled versus non-rescaled profiles), CMB map filtering schemes and noise levels. In contrast to galaxy and void statistics, we find that the Void x CMB lensing signal is less sensitive to the choice of mock catalog, indicating that future tensions with data are unlikely to stem from mock inaccuracies alone. The highest S/N is achieved for 2D voids with rescaled profiles. We forecast S/N ~13$σ$ (8$σ$) for 2D (3D) Roman voids combined with Planck, increasing to 22$σ$ (13$σ$) for SO and 31$σ$ (18$σ$) for CMB-S4-like surveys. While the cosmological dependence of this observable remains to be quantified, Roman together with next-generation of LSS and CMB surveys opens a path toward the first direct cosmological constraints from Void x CMB lensing.

papers.title: The impact of evolving dark energy on the Weyl potential measured from the Dark Energy Survey Year 3 data
papers.abstract: Measurements from the Dark Energy Survey (DES) Year 3 data have shown that the Weyl potential -- the sum of the spatial and temporal distortions of the geometry -- evolves more slowly than predicted by General Relativity, assuming a $Λ$CDM background evolution. An evolving dark energy with a phantom crossing, as preferred by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), is expected to decrease the depth of the gravitational potentials through a stronger acceleration than in $Λ$CDM, potentially solving the tension with General Relativity. In this paper, we show that $w_0w_a$CDM models indeed reduce the tension with respect to $Λ$CDM, down to a level of $1.6-2.2σ$, depending on the treatment of CMB lensing. This reduction is not due to an increase in the Weyl potential's uncertainties, but truly to the impact of the evolving background on the theoretical predictions in General Relativity. More data are needed to robustly determine if evolving dark energy fully explains the low value of the Weyl potential at intermediate redshifts, or if modifications of gravity or interactions in the dark sector are needed, which could simultaneously stabilize the phantom crossing indicated by DESI.

analysis.title_zh: 演化暗能量对暗能量巡天第三年数据测得的 Weyl 势的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 DES Year 3 所测 Weyl 势偏低/演化偏慢的问题，检验带幻影跨越的 w0waCDM 演化暗能量背景能否缓解与广义相对论预言的张力。摘要报告称，相比 ΛCDM，w0waCDM 可将张力降至 1.6-2.2σ，且原因是背景演化改变了 GR 下的理论预言，而不是简单扩大了 Weyl 势误差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Weyl 势直接关系到弱引力透镜和 CMB 透镜所探测的时空扰动总和，因此它是连接低红移大尺度结构、CMB 透镜以及引力理论检验的关键量。若演化暗能量能解释 DES 中间红移 Weyl 势偏低，将影响我们如何解读 CMB lensing、低红移结构增长张力以及是否需要修改引力或暗扇区相互作用。

摘要强调张力降低来自演化背景对 GR 理论预言的影响，而非误差增大。

Weyl potential 测量与广义相对论理论预言比较

papers.title: Machine Learning Techniques for Astrophysics and Cosmology: Lyman-$α$ forest
papers.abstract: The Lyman-$α$ forest refers to the series of absorption features observed in the spectra of distant quasars that are produced by neutral hydrogen in the intergalactic medium. Observed over a wide range of redshifts with both ground- and space-based facilities, the Lyman-$α$ forest provides a powerful probe of numerous physical processes, including the thermal state of intergalactic gas, the timing and topology of cosmic reionization, the expansion history of the Universe, the growth of cosmic structure, massive neutrinos, and the nature of dark matter. This chapter reviews the transformative impact of machine-learning techniques on Lyman-$α$ forest analyses, particularly in overcoming the computational and methodological limitations of traditional approaches. We discuss a broad range of machine-learning applications, including the automated characterization of individual absorption systems, improved reconstruction of the intrinsic quasar continuum, accelerated emulation of hydrodynamical simulations, and the development of simulation-based analyses, field-level inference methods, and three-dimensional reconstruction techniques for the underlying matter density field. As current and upcoming surveys continue to increase both the volume and precision of Lyman-$α$ forest observations, ML-driven pipelines are becoming an essential component of next-generation astrophysical and cosmological analyses.

papers.title: Signatures of Modified Gravity on Linear Scales in a Dynamical Dark Energy Background
papers.abstract: Cosmological data from the cosmic microwave background (CMB), baryon acoustic oscillations, and Type Ia supernovae suggest that the component driving the accelerated expansion of the Universe may be dynamical at the $\sim 2.5$-$3σ$ CL. The best-fit CPL model produces a level of cosmic structure similar to that of $Λ$CDM, with both models exhibiting mild tension with redshift-space distortion data. In this {\it Letter}, we parametrize possible departures of the effective gravitational coupling from Newton's constant in the late Universe, below a comoving scale $λ_c$, using two redshift bins, $0 \leq z < 1$ and $1 \leq z \leq 3$. We then determine the optimal values of $λ_c$ and the amplitude of these deviations from General Relativity, assuming a background with dynamical dark energy in CPL form. We find that, in order to achieve the required suppression of structure growth at low redshifts while remaining consistent with CMB constraints -- primarily from the late-time ISW effect at low $\ell$ and lensing at high $\ell$ -- we must require modified gravity effects to have a characteristic scale of $λ_c \lesssim 150\,\mathrm{Mpc}$ (95\% CL). This places the relevant scales squarely within the range probed by galaxy surveys. The best-fit value is $λ_c \simeq 40\,\mathrm{Mpc}$, well below the 95\% CL upper limit. Using Planck PR4, DESI DR2, Pantheon+ (or DES-Dovekie) and redshift-space distortions data we confirm that a CPL background with standard gravity is moderately preferred over $Λ$CDM; this preference strengthens to a mildly strong level when modified gravity effects are included. This enhancement leaves the CPL parameters largely unchanged, but shifts them slightly further into the quintom region.

analysis.title_zh: 动力学暗能量背景中线性尺度上的修改引力信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 CPL 动力学暗能量背景下，用两个红移区间和特征共动尺度 λc 参数化晚期有效引力耦合相对牛顿常数的偏离，以解释低红移结构增长抑制并保持与 CMB 约束一致。摘要报告称，结合 Planck PR4、DESI DR2、Pantheon+ 或 DES-Dovekie 以及 RSD 数据，修改引力效应需位于 λc≲150 Mpc 的尺度内，最佳拟合约为 40 Mpc，并使 CPL 相对 ΛCDM 的偏好增强。

papers.title: Blue-tilted Runnings and the JWST Early Galaxy Tension
papers.abstract: The recent James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations reported the unexpectedly large abundance of massive galaxies with stellar masses of $\sim 10^{10}~M_{\odot}$ at high redshifts $z \simeq 6.5 - 9$ compared with the prediction of the standard $Λ$CDM model. As a possible solution to the tension, we consider a blue-tilted spectrum of density perturbations with a positive running. We find that, for $α_s \simeq 0.02$ and $β_s \simeq 0.02$, a joint analysis with CMB observations shows that the tension can be resolved at the 1$σ$ confidence level. Such a blue-tilted spectrum is also plausible from the perspective of primordial black hole formation on much smaller scales in the early Universe.

analysis.title_zh: 蓝倾 running 与 JWST 早期星系张力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 JWST 在 z≈6.5-9 发现的约 10^10 M_⊙ 大质量星系丰度偏高问题，提出带正 running 的蓝倾密度扰动谱作为可能解释。摘要报告称，当 α_s≈0.02、β_s≈0.02 时，与 CMB 观测的联合分析可使该张力在 1σ 置信水平内得到缓解，并指出这种谱形也与更小尺度原初黑洞形成的设想有关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接触及原初扰动谱从 CMB 尺度外推到星系形成尺度的问题；若需要较大的正 running 来解释 JWST 早期星系，将反过来检验 CMB 对标量谱指数及其 running 的约束，并影响小尺度功率谱、结构形成和原初黑洞情景。
key_points: 针对 JWST 高红移大质量星系丰度与标准 ΛCDM 预言之间的张力。
提出带正 running 的蓝倾密度扰动谱，并与 CMB 观测联合分析。
摘要称在 α_s≈0.02、β_s≈0.02 时，张力可在 1σ 置信水平内得到解决。
methods: JWST 高红移星系丰度观测

papers.title: Negative neutrino mass or negative dark energy?
papers.abstract: Recent cosmological analyses based on DESI and CMB data have revealed a tension between the inferred sum of neutrino masses and the minimum value allowed by neutrino oscillation experiments, when assuming an underlying $Λ$CDM model of cosmology. In this work, we perform a systematic exploration of alternative dark energy models, including models that can supply a negative dark energy density capable of reproducing the cosmological effects of negative effective neutrino masses. We argue that dark energy models can alleviate the tension by modifying the cosmic expansion rate over a specific redshift range relevant for CMB lensing, while matching BAO distance measurements from DESI at lower redshifts. Among the models considered, we find that a sign-switching cosmological constant model, $Λ_\mathrm{s}$CDM, is uniquely capable of recovering positive neutrino masses by modifying the expansion history in this way. For the combination of DESI DR2 BAO, CMB, and DES-Dovekie supernova data, the constraint on the effective neutrino mass shifts from $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}=-0.075^{+0.039}_{-0.053}$ eV (68%) for $Λ$CDM to $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}=0.055\pm0.050$ eV (68%) for $Λ_\mathrm{s}$CDM, with a 95% lower bound on the dark energy transition redshift, $z_\dagger>2.4$. Although $Λ_\mathrm{s}$CDM does not have the strongest overall statistical support among the models considered, when the $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}$ parameter is allowed to vary, our findings point toward a specific sign- and redshift-structured contribution to the late-time expansion history as a viable way to alleviate the neutrino mass tension.

analysis.title_zh: 负中微子质量，还是负暗能量？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 DESI 和 CMB 数据在 ΛCDM 假设下给出的中微子质量和振荡实验下限之间的张力，系统考察替代暗能量模型能否通过改变特定红移范围内的宇宙膨胀来模拟负有效中微子质量效应。摘要报告称，符号切换宇宙学常数模型 Λ_sCDM 能将 DESI DR2 BAO+CMB+DES-Dovekie 超新星组合下的有效中微子质量约束从负值移至正值，并给出暗能量转变红移的下限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜对物质聚集和几何距离敏感，中微子质量约束又与晚期膨胀史存在退化；该论文把 DESI BAO、CMB 和超新星数据中的中微子质量张力重新解释为暗能量红移结构问题，对用 CMB lensing 推断中微子质量和暗能量性质具有直接相关性。
key_points: 研究 DESI 与 CMB 联合分析中有效中微子质量偏负的问题。
系统考察替代暗能量模型，特别是可产生负暗能量密度效应的模型。
摘要称符号切换宇宙学常数 Λ_sCDM 可将有效中微子质量约束移至正值。
methods: 替代暗能量模型系统探索
Λ_sCDM 符号切换宇宙学常数模型
CMB lensing 相关红移范围的膨胀史修改
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对负有效中微子质量与负暗能量效应之间的参数退化如何建立、Λ_sCDM 的转变红移先验和稳定性假设，以及模型比较中为何其总体统计支持并非最强但仍被强调。

papers.title: CosmoForge I: A unified framework for QML power spectrum estimation and pixel-based likelihood analysis
papers.abstract: Optimal power spectrum estimation on the largest angular scales of the cosmic microwave background relies on the Quadratic Maximum Likelihood (QML) estimator. Existing public implementations, however, each address only a subset of the problem and none combine power spectrum estimation with a self-consistent pixel-space likelihood within a single framework. We present CosmoForge, a public Python framework that unifies QML power spectrum estimation and pixel-based Gaussian likelihood evaluation for spin-0 and spin-2 fields on the sphere, with general (non-diagonal) noise covariances. The framework is split into three installable packages: CosmoCore (infrastructure), QUBE (Fisher and QML estimation), and PICSLike (pixel-space likelihood). A common interface exposes two interchangeable computation bases $-$ a harmonic basis built on the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity and a direct pixel-space basis $-$ selecting whichever is cheaper for the configuration at hand. Exact algorithmic optimisations reduce the Fisher cost to $\mathcal{O}(\ell_{\rm max}^4)$ for arbitrary noise covariances, with Numba JIT compilation of the hot kernels and MPI parallelisation of the likelihood scan. CosmoForge reproduces the Planck low-$\ell$ Fortran reference implementation across both the QML and pixel-space likelihood pipelines, consistently with double-precision arithmetic. Native multipole binning and three output normalisations (deconvolved, decorrelated, window-convolved) are exposed through a single code path, and the same covariance infrastructure powers both QML estimation and likelihood evaluation. CosmoForge offers a general-purpose, modular, and validated tool for the optimal analysis of large-scale data on the sphere. It is publicly available, pip-installable, and extensible to non-CMB observables.
papers.comment: Prepared for submission to A&A, 20 pages, 6 figures

papers.title: Information Content of the Cosmic Web
papers.abstract: We present an information-theoretic analysis of the Cosmic Web that goes beyond the scalar density contrast and exploits the full structure of the tidal deformation tensor. The three eigenvalues ($λ_1, λ_2, λ_3$) of the tidal Hessian furnish a natural morphological classifier: clusters, filaments, walls, and voids correspond to (+,+,+), (+,+,-), (+,-,-), and (-,-,-) sign patterns, and their joint probability distribution function (PDF), known analytically in the linear regime from Doroshkevich (1970), defines a continuous Shannon entropy that quantifies the information encoded in the geometry of large-scale structure. Additional information resides in the shear invariants ${\cal Q} = {\rm Tr}(T^2)$ and ${\cal A} = {\rm Tr}(T^3)$, independent of the density. We derive the {\it Log-Doroshkevich distribution}, and show the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry survives the nonlinear map, broken only in matter fractions. Gravitational collapse breaks it through the density skewness: an Edgeworth treatment gives the cluster--void asymmetry $\mathcal{R}_{\rm cv}-1=0.609\,\varepsilon_3$ and entropy difference $ΔH_{\rm CV}=0.107\,\varepsilon_3$ bits, with $\varepsilon_3=S_3^{\rm tot}(R)\,σ_0(R)\,D(z)$. The total skewness combines a gravitational term $S_3^{\rm grav}=34/7+n_{\rm eff}(R)$ and a primordial one $S_3^{\rm PNG}=S_3^{(1)}(R)\,f_{\rm NL}$ with $S_3^{(1)}(8\,h^{-1}{\rm Mpc})\simeq3\times10^{-4}$, smaller by four to five orders of magnitude, so the one-point asymmetry is gravity-dominated and only weakly sensitive to $f_{\rm NL}$. The multifractal entropy rate obeys $\dot H_{\rm mf}(z)=-3f(z)/(1+z)$, a growth probe complementary to $fσ_8$.
